content.title: Booking Holdings completes 25-for-1 stock split and increases authorized shares
content.text: ByPublished 04/02/2026, 06:50 PMBooking Holdings completes 25-for-1 stock split and increases authorized shares announced Thursday that it has completed a twenty-five-for-one forward stock split of its common stock. The company also increased the number of its authorized common shares from 1 billion to 25 billion. According to a statement in a press release filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the amendment to Booking Holdings’ Restated Certificate of Incorporation was filed with the Delaware Secretary of State and became effective at 4:01 p.m. Eastern Time on Thursday. Trading on a split-adjusted basis is expected to begin at the market open on Monday. The filing also lists the adjustment as previously announced and notes that the amendment to the company’s certificate is included as an exhibit to the report. Booking Holdings’ common stock is listed on the NASDAQ Global Select Market under the ticker symbol BKNG. The company also has multiple series of senior notes registered on the NASDAQ Stock Market LLC. The information in this article is based on a press release statement included in a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission. The company circulated a formal notice and accompanying proxy materials to all holders of its common shares and American Depositary Shares on April 16. According to a statement based on a press release and filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the notice includes proxy cards and voting instructions for both common shareholders and holders of American Depositary Shares. These materials provide details on how shareholders can attend and vote at the upcoming meeting. The company clarified that this filing does not constitute a proxy solicitation. Shareholders are advised to refer to the distributed notice and proxy cards for specific instructions related to participation and voting procedures. Further details, including the notice of the meeting and proxy cards, were furnished as exhibits to the SEC filing. Medirom Healthcare Technologies is incorporated in Japan and provides personal services, as indicated in the filing. This information is based on a press release statement included in the company’s Form 6-K filing with the SEC. In other recent news, reported a significant development as it secured a US$276 million share of a US$691 million contract for the Howard A. Hanson Dam project in Washington State. This contract, part of a joint venture with FlatironDragados, will be included in Aecon’s Construction segment backlog for the first quarter of 2026. Additionally, Aecon has expanded its presence in the U.S. by acquiring Duna Services, LLC and its subsidiaries for $60 million, with the deal financed through a revolving credit facility. Furthermore, Aecon has appointed Jeff Lyash to its Board of Directors, with plans for him to stand for election at the company’s Annual General Meeting in June 2026.Meanwhile, faced a downgrade from BMO Capital, which adjusted the company’s rating to Market Perform from Outperform, citing concerns over its earnings growth prospects. BMO Capital set a price target of $52.00, reflecting a cautious outlook on the real estate investment trust’s financial future. Despite this, Alexandria Real Estate announced a quarterly cash dividend of $0.72 per common share, payable in April 2026. These developments provide investors with a comprehensive view of recent activities and strategic decisions by both Aecon and Alexandria Real Estate. There were 116,326 broker non-votes on this matter. The approval comes as Winmark has maintained dividend payments for 17 consecutive years, currently offering a 3.65% yield—though InvestingPro data suggests the stock may be overvalued at current levels. The appointment of Grant Thornton, LLP as Winmark’s independent registered public accounting firm for the 2026 fiscal year was ratified, receiving 3,119,355 votes for, 26,488 against, and 3,543 abstentions. Furthermore, the company declared a subsequent quarterly dividend of $1.02 per share, set to be distributed on June 1, 2026, for shareholders on record by May 13, 2026. These dividends reflect the company’s ongoing commitment to returning value to its shareholders. Additionally, Winmark Corporation plans to introduce new fees for its franchise network starting September 1, 2026. This includes a monthly software fee of $295 per store, expected to generate about $400,000 monthly, which will be used for the support and modernization of its point-of-sale system. These developments indicate strategic changes within Winmark’s operational framework, aiming at enhancing technological infrastructure.
